_comment: Semantic channel map for Postiz. Keys are aliases used in scripts; values identify a channel by stable provider + handle (NOT the opaque Postiz integration id, which rotates on reconnect). These are the former albert-prep (mental-math) accounts, converted to this brand on 2026-09-21 (LOG.md). Resolve live ids with: BRAND=albert-prep-agent npm run social:resolve. Paid (Meta Ads) does not go through Postiz.
